what: New layout rule: app content capped at 1440px by the shared layout
why: Future pages must not re-introduce per-page width caps that drift from the app-wide standard
summary: Recorded the 1440px content-cap convention as a rule (shared `.app-main > :global(*)` lever in +layout.svelte + `--max-width: 90rem`; never per-page max-width, /pages 1024px cap removed). Updated the design-system entity page with the Layout token line and a 2026-09-15 lifecycle entry.
